I would downgrade 'structural_collapse' to 'texture_anomaly' or 'blur' as the door panel itself isn't warped, just the handle detail is lost. The perceptual_quality_auditor noted 'moderate compression,' which aligns with the slight pixelation seen in the background and on the vehicle body. All testable checkpoints regarding silhouette, windows, and general proportions are met. The vehicle is clearly identifiable as the target class.
artifact_reasoning: The primary artifacts are semantic/textual (illegible logo) and minor textural (soft mirrors/handles).
